name: Interest Amount 4
definition: Provides the elements related to the interest amount calculation.

InterestRequestSequence.name: Interest Request Sequence
InterestRequestSequence.definition: Indicates whether the interest request is new or updated.

InterestPeriod.name: Interest Period
InterestPeriod.definition: Period for which the calculation has been performed.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Amount of money representing an interest payment.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Agreed date for the interest payment.

InterestMethod.name: Interest Method
InterestMethod.definition: Indicates whether the interest will be settled in cash or rolled in the existing collateral balance.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Percentage charged for the use of an amount of money, usually expressed at an annual rate. The interest rate is the ratio of the amount of interest paid during a certain period of time compared to the principal amount of the interest bearing financial instrument.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Specifies the computation method of (accrued) interest of the security.

AppliedWithholdingTax.name: Applied Withholding Tax
AppliedWithholdingTax.definition: Amount or percentage of a cash distribution that will be withheld by a tax authority.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: Specifies whether the interest is simple or compounded.

CalculationFrequency.name: Calculation Frequency
CalculationFrequency.definition: Specifies the periodicity of the calculation of the interest.

CollateralPurpose.name: Collateral Purpose
CollateralPurpose.definition: Specifies whether the collateral has been posted against the variation margin, the segregated independent amount or to cover any other risk defined with a proprietary code.

OpeningCollateralBalance.name: Opening Collateral Balance
OpeningCollateralBalance.definition: Provides details about the opening collateral balance.

ClosingCollateralBalance.name: Closing Collateral Balance
ClosingCollateralBalance.definition: Provides details about the closing collateral balance.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additionnal information related to interest request.

ReferenceDetails.name: Reference Details
ReferenceDetails.definition: Additional references linked to the updated interest payement request.

InterestRequestSequenceRule.definition: If InterestRequestSequence equals updated, then ReferenceDetails must be present.
